meta.title: AlphaScope Newsroom
meta.description: A crypto-markets newsroom driven by verifiable trading data

login.title: Sign in to the newsroom
login.locked: Too many failures; the account is locked for a while

dashboard.title: Editor-in-chief dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Today's candidates, articles awaiting review, accounts and data sources. Every number comes from AlphaScope's observed sample.
dashboard.emergencyHint: Stops all publication records and AI work; sync and detection keep running.

pub.rejected: Sent back by the AI reviewer

dashboard.proposedHint: the AI editor-in-chief proposed them; drafting starts once accepted

events.title: News radar
events.subtitle: Programmatically detected candidates, each with a score breakdown and a credibility gate. Blocked events cannot enter the desk until the data recovers.

desk.title: AI desk
desk.headline: Headline
desk.stale: The facts changed: revise against the current packet
desk.packetOutdated: Written from an older fact packet
desk.ackDuplicate: I confirm this differs in substance from the similar article
desk.aiNote: AI only drafts; human edits are never overwritten by AI.
desk.factsVersionHint: The facts version this was written from; newer facts mean re-checking
desk.reply: First reply (post it under the tweet)

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Every draft is kept: search by account, state, language, event type and keywords.

stories.title: Stories
stories.subtitle: Each covered trader is a running story, from first event to outcome; every chapter pins the fact version it cited.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: The number of accounts follows content value and audience, not volume. An active account is ready to work; authorization is optional. Paused accounts get no coverage and cannot record posts, nor can accounts whose authorization is revoked or expired.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.auth: Authorization (optional: only revoked / expired stops publishing)
accounts.authExpires: Authorization expiry (optional, ISO time; publishing stops after it)
accounts.venues: Venues covered (comma-separated: hyperliquid, okx; X accounts: hyperliquid)
accounts.linkInThread: Full wallet address as the first reply
accounts.styleHelp: Used when no reporter style applies; reporters' defaults are under Settings → Rules
accounts.statusHelp: Active: gets coverage; paused: trials only; retired: unused
accounts.linkInThreadHelp: The post shows the short address; a reply like 'Wallet: 0x…' is written for you
accounts.replyLink: Add an explorer link to that reply
accounts.replyLinkHelp: Off by default: no free ads for the explorer

publications.title: Publications
publications.subtitle: Every record traces to an article version and fact packet; performance is entered by hand.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKey: API key (empty keeps the current one)
settings.price: Price (USD per million tokens: input, output)
settings.ruleHint: Changes are audited. Values are starting points to tune on real data.
settings.head: Source head

columns.title: Columns
columns.subtitle: Scheduled columns build their fact packets from data with deterministic code, then go through the same editor-in-chief, reporter, guard and review flow as news events. Thin data blocks an issue and it is retried.

board.title: Assignment desk
board.subtitle: Every open assignment: who is writing, how far along, when it is due. Overdue first.

calendar.title: Publication calendar
calendar.subtitle: Schedule approved articles in each account's time zone. Posts on one account keep the minimum gap; events older than 24 hours are flagged as possibly stale.

studio.compareHint: Each model writes one version from the same packet and brief; none replaces the current version.

public.title: AlphaScope data journalism
public.subtitle: Every whale story we published, how it turned out, and the mistakes we corrected. Data from AlphaScope's observed sample; not investment advice.
public.ledgerHint: Every position we reported on, kept whatever happened next.

settingsX.rpaHint: An external RPA uses this token to pull due plans and report results. A new token replaces the old one at once and is shown only once.
settingsX.presetHint: A preset fills in the protocol and URL; add your key. After saving, press "Test model", then select it under AI roles. An aicodemirror "no available channel" error means the model name is not supported.
settingsX.inherit: Empty: use the base reporter's model
settingsX.aiOff: AI is switched off (Settings → Rules & budgets → ai.enabled).
settingsX.noModelYet: No enabled AI model yet: add one under Settings → AI models.
settingsX.noTested: No enabled model has passed a test yet: press "Test model" under Settings → AI models.
settingsX.unbound: These AI roles have no model, so AI evaluation and drafting stay queued: {agents}.
settingsX.bindTitle: Bind a model to all roles
settingsX.bindHint: Sets the same primary and fallback model on the roles; each gets a new version (old ones are kept). You can still change a single role later.
settingsX.styleKeyHelp: zh_ for Chinese, en_ for English, e.g. zh_my_style; saving the same key adds a version

drafts.title: AI drafts
drafts.subtitle: Every recent AI version: model, guard verdict, cost and latency. Failures are listed with their reason, such as no model configured or a gateway block.

trial.title: Quick trial
trial.hint: Pick accounts and models and generate drafts right away. Works on paused accounts and blocked events; a trial never changes the event and cannot go to review.
trial.models: Models (none = the role's default; several = one draft each to compare)
trial.done: Queued; results appear in the articles below
trial.banner: This is a trial draft: edit, compare and export it, but it cannot go to review. To use it, assign the event to this account.
trial.styles: Styles (pick several to compare side by side)
trial.stylesHint: None picked: v3 uses the reporter's house style (Settings → Rules → styles), v1/v2 the account's.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.subtitle: Two drafts per event from the same model; editors judge them blind. Improvements are kept only if the data says so.
experiments.name: Name
experiments.how1: Arms A and B each write one draft; only what you set differs (prompt version / style / model). Default A = v3, B = v5 (a native prompt per language).
experiments.how2: Both drafts come from the same role, model and account style. They are trial drafts: the event is untouched and they cannot go to review.
experiments.how3: Review is blind: which draft is A or B is hidden and the order is random. Check the facts on the right; flag anything misleading.
experiments.how4: Success: B wins ≥ 65%, guard pass rate not below A, no more misleading drafts, ≤ 50% more tokens. Stop if contrast coverage < 40% or B wins < 55%.
experiments.createHint: Samples recent events (48h) by class, refreshes their facts, then queues both arms. Use it to compare prompts, styles or models.
experiments.allDone: You have judged every ready pair. Wait for the rest or open the results.
experiments.incomplete: Score all four for both drafts and pick the better one

dimHint.information: Does the reader learn something they can't get elsewhere
dimHint.lede: Does the first sentence say why it matters

experiments.resultsLocked: Results open once you have judged every ready pair (the editor-in-chief can always see them).
experiments.resultsSubtitle: A = current, B = contrast facts + story memory + prompt v2
experiments.coverageSub: share with two or more kinds of contrast

check.guard_not_worse: Guard pass rate not below A

stopReason.contrast_coverage_below_40pct: Contrast coverage below 40%: widen data coverage before tuning the writing
stopReason.b_win_rate_below_55pct: B wins below 55%: not worth it

experiments.familiesHint: pairs where each kind is available

family.radar: Radar memory (earlier positions on the coin)
family.crowd: Rank / share / timing traders in the sample

experiments.started: Experiment submitted: sampling and refreshing facts, then both drafts are queued. This page refreshes itself.

reason.no_recent_events: No position events for this account's venues in the last 48 hours
reason.gate_blocked: {n} events blocked by the gate after refresh (stale data or position gone)
reason.refresh_limit: {n} events skipped at the refresh limit

experiments.nameAuto: Leave empty for a unique name
experiments.styleDefault: Default: v3 the reporter's style, v1/v2 the account's
experiments.bModel: Arm B model (for a model comparison)

rating.title: Rate this version
rating.hint: 1–5, and what was good or wrong. Feeds the weekly quality report.

promptsX.switchHint: Point the general reporter and the five beat reporters at one version; a role without it is skipped with the reason. Only the prompt changes.
promptsX.switchConfirm: Switch every reporter to prompt v{v}? Automatic drafts will use it.
promptsX.intro: Each role has its own prompt. Versions are never edited: saving creates a new version and the old ones stay, so every post traces back to its prompt. A version no role and no draft ever used can be deleted.
promptsX.deleteConfirm: Delete prompt v{v}? This cannot be undone.
promptsX.deleteRule: Built-in versions and versions a role or a draft has used are kept for traceability; stop using them instead.
promptsX.viewEdit: View v{v} / save a new version from it
promptsX.notesHint: What changed, e.g. shorter hook, emoji allowed
promptsX.saved: Saved as a new version; pick it under AI roles to use it
promptsX.langHint: Shared: both Chinese and English accounts use it
promptsX.newVersionNote: Saving creates a new version number; pick it for a role under AI roles to use it.
promptsX.switchLatest: Every role to its newest version
promptsX.switchLatestConfirm: Switch every role to its newest prompt version?
promptsX.editRole: Change this role (model, prompt version, limits)
promptsX.maxTokens: Max output tokens per call (higher costs more, too low truncates)
promptsX.fallbackSkippedHint: A fallback that failed its test is skipped. Pick a working model or leave it empty

eic.name: AI editor-in-chief
eic.desc: Decides whether an event is worth covering, which account takes it and from what angle. Runs on automatic coverage; its notes are for editors.

reporter.name: General reporter
reporter.desc: Writes when no beat reporter is set. Default style: one-liner.

reporter_breaking.name: Breaking reporter
reporter_breaking.desc: Big opens, adds and flips. Default style: whale alert.

reporter_investigator.name: Whale investigator
reporter_investigator.desc: A trader's record and backstory, told as a series. Default style: dossier.

reporter_data.name: Data reporter
reporter_data.desc: Rankings, rarity, longs vs shorts. Default style: smart money vs whale.

reporter_derivatives.name: Derivatives risk reporter
reporter_derivatives.desc: Leverage, liquidation prices, adding underwater. Default style: degen desk.

reporter_historian.name: Running-story reporter
reporter_historian.desc: Follow-ups and endings of positions we covered. Default style: how it ended.

editor_zh.name: Chinese editor
editor_zh.desc: Runs when you click Polish: makes a Chinese draft read natively.

editor_en.name: English editor
editor_en.desc: Runs when you click Polish: makes an English draft read like a native US poster wrote it.

fact_checker.name: Fact checker
fact_checker.desc: Runs when you click Fix: rewrites a draft to clear the checker's findings.

reviewer.name: AI desk reviewer
reviewer.desc: Reads each fact-checked draft like a native reader: AI smell, native voice, hook, ready or not; approves to ready-to-post or sends one revision to the editor.

UNMATCHED_NUMBER.what: This number isn't in the facts
UNMATCHED_NUMBER.fix: Use a figure from the facts (rounding is fine) or drop it

UNMATCHED_DATE.what: This date isn't in the facts
UNMATCHED_DATE.fix: Drop the date or use one from the facts

UNMATCHED_TIME.what: This time isn't in the facts
UNMATCHED_TIME.fix: No clock times: say 'just' / 'in the past few hours'

LIQ_NOT_IN_FACTS.what: Says liquidated, but there is no liquidation

PNL_SIGN.what: Profit and loss the wrong way round
PNL_SIGN.fix: Positive in the facts is a gain, negative a loss

EXACT_TIME_CLAIM.what: Exact time claimed, only a window is known

OPEN_NOT_OBSERVED.what: Says 'just opened', but the position was first seen

NOTIONAL_AS_MARGIN.what: Position value written as his own money
NOTIONAL_AS_MARGIN.fix: Only cite margin as the estimate, with '~'

IDENTITY_CLAIM.what: Guesses who's behind it or implies inside info
IDENTITY_CLAIM.fix: Drop it; a rhetorical 'Does he know something??' is fine

ADVICE_OR_GUARANTEE.fix: Remove it; stick to the facts

STYLE_PHRASE.what: A phrase on the style's avoid list

RECENCY_STALE.what: More than 3 hours since it was seen: not 'just' any more

UNKNOWN_FACT.what: Cites facts not in the packet

FACT_PACKET_SUPERSEDED.what: The facts changed after this version was written
FACT_PACKET_SUPERSEDED.fix: Regenerate, or check and save again

TOO_LONG.fix: Cut a line or a number, or make it a thread

LABEL_MISMATCH.what: This figure isn't the thing it's labelled as
LABEL_MISMATCH.fix: e.g. the mark price written as the liquidation price: use the matching fact for liquidation and entry prices

gateCodes.CONTRADICTED_BY_CONTEXT: The position was gone when we checked (in and out fast?)
gateCodes.FIRST_SEEN_ONLY: Already held when first seen: not an open

constraintCodes.OBSERVED_SAMPLE: Our tracked sample, not the whole market
constraintCodes.NO_IDENTITY: Who's behind the wallet is unknown
constraintCodes.NOTIONAL_NOT_MARGIN: Position value is not his money
constraintCodes.TIME_WINDOW_ONLY: Only a time window is known
constraintCodes.PNL_ESTIMATED_FROM_MARK: Closing P&L estimated from the mark
constraintCodes.OKX_LEAD_ASSETS: OKX assets are the lead account only
constraintCodes.CROWD_SAMPLE: Crowd figures are a sample snapshot
constraintCodes.HEDGE_POSSIBLE: Big opposite positions: maybe a hedge
constraintCodes.ARCHIVE_PARTIAL: The trade archive covers part of his history
constraintCodes.RADAR_SINCE: Radar memory starts when we began tracking

ai__enabled.desc: Off pauses every AI draft and review

ai__auto_eic.name: Automatic coverage
ai__auto_eic.desc: High-scoring events go to the AI editor-in-chief

detect__auto_eic_score.name: Auto-review score
detect__auto_eic_score.desc: Only events above this go to the EIC

review__four_eyes.name: Four eyes
review__four_eyes.desc: Authors can't approve their own drafts

desk__language.name: Desk language
desk__language.desc: Language of notes written for editors

detect__tiers_usd.name: Size tiers
detect__tiers_usd.desc: A follow-up needs a new tier

review__ai_ready.name: AI-approved drafts go to ready-to-post
review__ai_ready.desc: Off: every draft needs a person's approval

desk__auto_accept.name: Autopilot: accept AI proposals
desk__auto_accept.desc: On: events the AI editor-in-chief proposes are accepted and drafted at once, no manual accept on the Assignments page. Drafts still go through the fact check and the AI reviewer before reaching the publish center. Proposals with duplicate, identity or unconfirmed-liquidation risks still wait for a person. Spends on AI (within the daily budget).

desk__auto_min_priority.name: Lowest priority to autopilot
desk__auto_min_priority.desc: Only proposals at this priority or higher are taken automatically (P0 is the highest). P1 suggested: major and important stories are written, the rest wait for a pick.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.intro: Do these six steps in order and the system finds news and drafts posts on its own; you review and publish. This box disappears when you're done.

model.title: Add an AI model and test it
model.how: Settings → AI models: pick a preset, add the key, click Test

bind.title: Bind the AI roles to the model
bind.how: AI roles: 'Bind a model to all roles'

account.title: Turn on at least one account
account.how: Accounts: set the status to Active (authorization is optional)

prompts.title: Put the reporters on the newest prompts
prompts.how: AI roles: 'Every role to its newest version'

trial.title: Try a draft
trial.how: Open an event on the radar and use Quick trial with a few styles

publish.title: Review and record the first post
publish.how: Library: submit, approve, post it, then Record publication in the editor

firewall.what: The provider's firewall blocks this server
firewall.fix: Their Cloudflare won't let the server IP 194.163.135.37 in. Ask them to allow it or use another provider; don't keep it as a fallback

bad_key.fix: Re-enter the key under AI models and test again

no_channel.what: Wrong model name or model not enabled
no_channel.fix: Use the model name from the provider's docs

rate_limit.fix: Retried automatically; lower concurrency if frequent

server.fix: Usually recovers; switch to the fallback if it persists

timeout.fix: Raise the timeout or use a faster model

truncated.fix: Retried with more room; raise max output tokens; turn DeepSeek thinking off

format.fix: Rewritten automatically; change the JSON mode or the model if frequent

too_long.fix: Rewritten automatically; the newest prompts state the budget and avoid this

budget.what: Today's AI budget is used up
budget.fix: Raise the daily budget or wait until tomorrow

review.none: No AI review yet (the reviewer has no model, or this version failed the fact check)

dimHint.native: Reads like a native crypto poster
dimHint.hook: Does line one stop the scroll
dimHint.clarity: Clear at a glance, not number soup
dimHint.risk: Hype, inside-info hints, sample called the market

publish.title: Publish
publish.subtitle: Every post worth sending: preview, copy, open X, then record it with 'I posted it'.

tabHint.ready: Approved by the AI reviewer or a person, soonest to expire first.
tabHint.todo: Written but not approved yet: the reviewer asked for changes or a person, facts changed, or trials.
tabHint.published: Posts that went out, with their records.
tabHint.expired: Posts that ran out of time. Rewrite from fresh facts if the position moved on.

empty.ready: Nothing ready yet. Drafts land here once the AI reviewer approves them.

publish.replyLabel: First reply (post it under the tweet)
publish.intentHint: Opens X's composer with the text; add the card by hand
publish.expiredConfirm: This post expired. Did it go out anyway?
publish.copyFailed: Copy failed: select and copy by hand
publish.editedToggle: Edited it before posting? Paste what went out and it's checked again
publish.editedPlaceholder: The text you actually posted (leave empty if unchanged)
publish.checkBlocked: The edited text fails the fact check and can't be recorded: fix or delete the post on X first
publish.checkWarn: The edited text has warnings: check them, then Record anyway
publish.editedPosted: The posted text differs from the approved version
publish.pairHint: Chinese and English posts on the same event side by side; the other language comes along from any tab.
publish.noPartner: No {lang} post on this event yet

tokens.hint: For browser extensions, RPA or other programs: they list ready posts, take one, report back and send metrics. Each token can be limited to accounts and disabled any time; every call is logged.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.createHint: The token is shown once: copy it now.

tokens.docs: Full reference: newsroom/docs/15-publish-api.md in the repository
